references.text: The same formulation about removing the evil from your midst, used concerning false prophets
The principle of removing the evil from the people is repeated in connection with the death penalty
The same expression about rooting out the evil from Israel is used regarding disobedience to the priest or judge
The formulation about removing the evil from your midst is repeated in the punishment of a rebellious son
The same principle of removing the evil from Israel applied to sexual immorality

The same expression used regarding removing the evil through kidnapping

The principle of retribution - do to others as you would have them do to you
Paul quotes this principle about driving out the wicked from the congregation
